mission: Advance the existing repository-skill provenance probe against the open skills-root TOCTOU wound without touching Phone Hands/P0 or creating a second probe.
planned_fronts: reject Windows directory-junction roots alongside symlink roots before traversal
capture a no-follow skills-root identity before candidate enumeration and revalidate it after enumeration before any title/hash authority
fail closed with zero SkillRecord authority if the root type/identity changes across enumeration
add hostile regression source for junction admission where supported and persistent root replacement between admission and post-enumeration revalidation
mutate the existing accessible Warm Wall in place only if the topology state materially changes
attempt She-Raw hostile review; preserve connector failure exactly if unavailable

will_claim: cross-platform pre/post no-follow root identity revalidation source
persistent root replacement detection before per-file title/hash authority
will_not_claim: atomic no-follow traversal on every Python platform
elimination of swap-and-restore races that occur entirely between the two identity observations

source_notes: Python 3.13 documents os.scandir file-descriptor support on Unix only, so a universal directory-fd no-follow implementation would not be cross-platform.
Python pathlib exposes Windows directory-junction detection separately from symlink detection, so root topology admission must not treat is_symlink() as the whole name-surrogate surface.
